implemented: Explicitly remove only the target attempt identity from private root and owned cleanup session tables during disposal, including roots unsubscribed before LOGOFF.
After bind unwinds, reuse a verified target entry on the borrowed caller for failed-handoff LOGOFF; create one recovery candidate only when that entry is absent and root is closed.
Use existing native public suite on both Java 21 and actual Java 8; preserve the default Java 8 transport/provider profile.

regression_before.finding: All four root-loss variants retained the failed target in the disposed private root table. No new nonce collision was observed.
